wwn_deluxe.title: Worlds Without Number, Deluxe Edition
wwn_deluxe.availability: authorised copy supplied by the author; not redistributable, not in the repository

source.wwn_srd: https://wwn.quadrifons.com/ (cross-check only; the SRD omits the Deluxe sections)

statuses.verified: a WWN procedure implemented in src/rules with tests that pin the printed numbers
statuses.verified_reuse: the identical procedure already exists for CWN; one resolver is shared and a test proves the WWN numbers
statuses.partial: some of the section is implemented and the remainder is named
statuses.missing: no implementation; the gap is recorded so it cannot be mistaken for coverage
statuses.unverified: an equivalent CWN procedure exists but equivalence to the WWN numbers has not been proven
statuses.not_applicable: setting text, an example, or a vocabulary the CWN-first design does not reimplement

rows.title: Attributes
rows.note: Identical table to WWN p.8 (3 → -2, 4-7 → -1, 8-13 → 0, 14-17 → +1, 18 → +2). CWN's resolver is used unchanged; a test pins the WWN bands against it.

rows.title: Skills
rows.note: 2d6 + skill level + attribute modifier, -1 when untrained, success on >= difficulty (WWN pp.9, 41). One resolver, shared with CWN.

rows.title: Skill checks
rows.note: Same procedure as the Skills section; the WWN chapter restates it. Verified against the CWN resolver, not reimplemented.

rows.title: Backgrounds
rows.note: WWN backgrounds (pp.11-17) generate skill picks and Growth rolls. No code; CWN backgrounds are a different table and do not substitute.

rows.title: Choosing a class
rows.note: Warrior / Expert / Mage / Adventurer packages (pp.18-21) have no implementation. CWN's class list must not be overwritten to host them.

rows.title: Foci
rows.note: WWN Foci (p.22) are a character-option subsystem with no CWN equivalent; nothing is implemented.

rows.title: Final touches
rows.note: Hit points by class die (p.28), free skill and starting languages. Depends on classes; not implemented.

rows.title: Equipment packages
rows.note: WWN starting packages (p.29) are content; no catalogue in data/.

rows.title: Encumbrance
rows.note: CWN implements encumbrance (src/rules/cwn_encumbrance.py); WWN's readyload/Stow values on p.32 have not been compared, so equivalence is unproven.

rows.title: Character advancement
rows.note: CWN advancement exists; WWN's XP table and partial-class progression (p.54) are not verified against it.

rows.title: Time and Saving Throws
rows.note: Scenes/turns are shared vocabulary, but WWN's saving throws (p.40) are not proven identical to cwn_core.save_target, which is CWN SRD 2.2.0 with a 16 - level - attribute formula. Needs a comparison before either is claimed.

rows.title: Combat
rows.note: CWN combat (src/rules/cwn_combat.py) is the resolver; WWN's Shock and combat tables (pp.42-47) have not been checked against it.

rows.title: Common combat actions
rows.note: WWN's action list (p.44) overlaps CWN's; neither equality nor divergence is recorded.

rows.title: Injury, healing, and system strain
rows.note: System Strain exists in CWN (cwn_core.strain_maximum, Strain). WWN's healing and strain-recovery text (p.48) has not been compared.

rows.title: Falling and Travel
rows.note: Falling damage and travel rates (p.49) unimplemented.

rows.title: High mages
rows.note: Full class procedure: Effort pool, preparation and recovery, Arts. Existing implementation audited, not rewritten (#1044).

rows.title: High magic spell list
rows.note: 83 spell identities in data/rules/wwn_spells.json (52 High Magic, 15 Elementalist, 16 Necromancer) with the learning procedure.

rows.title: Spells of the high mages
rows.note: 13 of 83 effect rows resolve (High Magic level 1, PR #1095). The remaining 70 are #1085's increments; untranscribed() reports them rather than faking them.

rows.title: Elementalists
rows.note: The 15 Elementalist spell identities are catalogued and resolvable through the shared catalogue API, but the class procedure — Effort pool, Arts, preparation (p.76) — is not implemented.

rows.title: Necromancers
rows.note: Same shape as the Elementalist: the 16 Necromancer spell identities are catalogued, the class procedure (p.82) is missing.

rows.title: Healers
rows.note: The Healer tradition (p.80) has neither a class procedure nor its Arts.

rows.title: Vowed
rows.note: The Vowed (p.86) has neither a class procedure nor its Arts.

rows.title: Developing new spells
rows.note: Spell research (p.88): the research cost and time procedure is not implemented.

rows.title: Building magical workings
rows.note: Magical workings (p.90): the cost/time procedure for permanent enchantments is not implemented.

rows.title: Creating magic items
rows.note: Magic item creation (p.92): the creation procedure and its cost tables are not implemented.

rows.title: Planning your work
rows.note: Campaign-planning guidance (p.116); prose, not a procedure.

rows.title: Tags
rows.note: The tag systems (community/court/ruin/wilderness, pp.147-219) are a generator family; none implemented. NoöPunk's own tag vocabulary must not be conflated with these.

rows.title: Planning and running adventures
rows.note: Adventure structure guidance (p.228); prose plus procedure not implemented.

rows.title: Investigation challenges
rows.note: Investigation procedure (p.248) unimplemented; NoöPunk's GUMSHOE mod owns investigations and must not be replaced.

rows.title: Reaction rolls
rows.note: Reaction rolls (p.296): CWN has an NPC reaction procedure; WWN's 2d6 bands are not compared.

rows.title: Morale checks
rows.note: Morale checks (p.297): CWN has an NPC morale value; WWN's procedure is not compared.

rows.title: Major projects
rows.note: WWN Major Projects (p.336) with the project difficulty, adventure and allied-faction shares. The SWN faction turn stays a separate engine and is not merged into this.

rows.title: The faction turn
rows.note: WWN faction turn (p.324). SWN's faction engine exists and is a different system; WWN's turn is not implemented and must not be replaced by SWN's.

rows.title: Arts of the gyre
rows.note: Deluxe p.344 is now verified to exist in the authorised copy and its section index is recorded (data/rules/wwn_sections.json). No procedure is implemented; the six tradition Arts below are the increment.

rows.title: Heroic classes
rows.note: Heroic classes (p.356) unimplemented; they must stay optional packages and not alter CWN balance.

rows.title: Iterums and their dwellers
rows.note: Iterums (p.370) unimplemented; NoöPunk's interdimensional layer must adapt these, not restate them.

rows.title: Iterums
rows.chapter: The World of the Latter Earth

rows.title: Summary of character creation
rows.note: Checklist page (p.6); the procedures it lists are the rows above.

rows.title: Skill list
rows.note: The skill vocabulary (p.10). CWN's skill list is authoritative for CWN characters; WWN's list applies only to WWN-native characters.

rows.title: Hirelings
rows.note: Hireling rules (p.34): CWN implements hireling wages; WWN's costs are not compared.

rows.title: Background
rows.note: Background entry format (p.12); part of the Backgrounds row.

rows.title: Elementalist new magic
rows.note: Spell entries (p.78); the identities are catalogued, effects are #1085's increments.
